writer.lookup.title: Dictionary and translation
writer.lookup.intro: Look up a word in a free dictionary, or translate the text in this box. DeepL receives only that text, using the key saved on your account.

writer.lookup.error.missingKey: Save a DeepL key in your account before translating.
writer.lookup.error.rejected: DeepL rejected the saved key. Check it in your account keys.
writer.lookup.error.quota: DeepL could not take this translation. The quota on that key may be used up.
writer.lookup.error.language: DeepL does not translate into that language.
writer.lookup.error.length: Enter a shorter passage. This box is for a selection, not a whole chapter.
writer.lookup.error.signedOut: Sign in to translate with your DeepL key.
writer.lookup.error.failed: DeepL did not return a translation. Try again, or open a web translator.

writer.todo.title: Writing Progress & Goals
writer.todo.description: Track your writing tasks and goals for this chapter.
writer.todo.dailyTooltip: For stories published every day. Shorter chapters help maintain daily engagement and work well for serialized content.
writer.todo.biDailyTooltip: For stories published 3-4 times per week. Balanced length that allows for detailed storytelling while maintaining reader engagement.
writer.todo.weeklyTooltip: For stories published once per week. Longer chapters allow for more complex plots and character development.
writer.todo.monthlyTooltip: For stories published once per month. Much longer chapters suitable for in-depth storytelling and complex narratives.
